V. 46.
The Publicans—were Officers of the Revenue, Farmers, or Receivers of the public Money: Men employed by the Romans to gather the Taxes and Cuſtoms, which they exacted of the Nations they had conquered. Theſe were generally odious for their Extortion and Oppreſſion, and were reckoned by the Jews as the very Scum of the Earth.
